About

The one holding the running order.

Bhoza Mphela works where South African music, events, marketing and media overlap.

She started on air, presenting at Audwax and DYR. In 2003 she began managing artists and has not stopped. DJ Ganyani, DJ Josi Chave and Ismail Abrahams have been on her roster, along with actors and actresses.

Alongside management came the nights themselves. She promoted clubs and venues, organised events, and became a voice brands trusted, Sorbet, Clinique and Five Roses among them. She also runs social media for clients.

She holds a music industry qualification from Wits University and is a partner at the Female DJ Network.

Today the same person can write the strategy, manage the artist, build the event, run the socials and take the mic on the night. That is the whole point of calling her Bhoza.
